svg.text: System architecture: from any data source to trusted answers, with a safety gate between the AI and your data.
profiling, autopilot charts, quality scan, transforms, investigation.
every AI-written, pinned or inspected query
SQLAlchemy engines keep live databases in place (read-only).
pandas loaders turn files, APIs and web tables into one SQLite file per source.
Guards: SSRF block · no redirects · 100 MB file / 10 MB page / 100k-row caps.
Your data stays where it is. Dictionary reads it, explains it, checks it, and never writes to it.
